payload.title: Create the GitHub OIDC provider and lab deploy role
payload.description: Needs Ryan's concrete approval: new IAM. The account lists no GitHub OIDC provider. Add a role such as cyclotron-lab-github-deploy trusting only AnthusAI/Cyclotron on refs/heads/main, with audience sts.amazonaws.com; check 'gh api repos/AnthusAI/Cyclotron/actions/oidc/customization/sub' because an immutable subject needs both forms (see Papyrus infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/site-config.ts). Allow only the stack's change-set calls, create-only upload under cyclotron-console/backend and templates, and the reads verification needs. Bring him the exact trust and permission policies. No stored keys. Account ids stay in repository variables, not Git.
